interpretation: Retrospective revision experiments; 2019-2025 has previously been examined and is not a pristine prospective holdout.
preprocessing_fit: Discovery period only for monthly climatology, anomaly mean/std, state quantiles and all effect-based selections.

hac.mask_handling: zero score contributions for excluded calendar rows, never compress time

multiple_testing: global across each explicitly defined experiment family

state_sensitivity.warning: Lagged states precede tested 1-3 step source terms but are not guaranteed exogenous.

editorial.exceptions: Require a clearly justified documented case; never infer exemption.
editorial.citation_style: Individual relevant citations at supporting statements, ordered by first appearance; avoid combined numeric citations and ranges.

completion_rule: An experiment is complete only with executed results, verified checks, provenance and limitations. Unrun or limited-scope components remain explicitly open.
